description: Read how far each shotlist shot (`sb_N`) of a project is covered — takes, the chosen take, the bound characters and location, and where it sits in the cut. Per shot: `takes_bild` / `takes_clip` (counts), `gewaehlt` (the chosen take, or null), `referenzen` (characters and location planned vs. actually bound), `im_schnitt` (clips in the sequence and how that was established) and `luecken`, which names what is still missing. `kopf` totals it up: shots overall, with a clip, with a chosen take, in the cut. A clip in the sequence WITHOUT a proven shot does not count as coverage — it is reported in `kopf.clips_im_schnitt_ohne_shot`. Clips nobody has reviewed yet count as `takes_clip`, never as `gewaehlt`. A project without a shotlist answers with `kopf.hinweis` = 'keine_shotliste' and no shots: that is a finding, not an error. Costs nothing, writes nothing — one read. NOT lab_shots: that one reads the shot layer of a sequence (which clips form one cut shot); this one reads the shotlist shots of the project and whether each has material.

project_id.description: Project id (from lab_list_projects) — positive integer as string
